title: "Did You Apply?" (LinkedIn)
description:
2024, the year of collaborative… job searching? I don’t know if “it takes a village to find a job” is quite accurate but where you can help out a fellow job seeker. Click “no” if you didn’t apply to a job on LinkedIn. Send jobs to a friend who is also looking. Take regular breaks from doom scrolling Indeed for group froyo. #jobseeker #jobseekers #jobapplication #jobapplications #linkedin #linkedintips
